faqs.question: What is your shipping policy?
faqs.answer: We offer standard shipping within and outside Nigeria. Shipping times and costs may vary based on your location and the size of your order. We ship globally - no matter where you are in the world, XBL will ALWAYS get to you.

faqs.question: How long does it take to make my outfit?
faqs.answer: It depends on the style you're opting for. We advise brides to make bookings at least 4 months in advance. If not, you'll have to pay for express design and fittings.

faqs.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, we do. We ship globally.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept direct bank transfers and major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover. We also accept payment via PayPal.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order has shipped, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number. You can use this number to track your order on our website or through the carrier's website.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: All sales made are final. We do not offer returns or refunds as the dresses made are specifically tailored to you.

faqs.question: Do you have a size guide?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer a size guide on our website to help you find the right fit for your body type. If you have any questions about sizing, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service team for assistance.

faqs.question: How do I book a consultation?
faqs.answer: You can book a consultation by contacting us via WhatsApp at +234 810 618 0911, calling +234 809 777 7577, or emailing xtrabrideslagos@yahoo.com. We're available Monday through Friday from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

faqs.question: What makes XBL different from other bridal designers?
faqs.answer: XBL is led by Paris-trained designer Oyetomiwa Elizabeth Daniel, known for her signature Velluto technique. We use only the finest materials including Italian Chantilly laces and Turkish tissue lace. Each piece is hand-sewn with meticulous attention to detail. We've dressed top African celebrities and are trusted by discerning brides globally.

faqs.question: Can I see examples of your work?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! You can visit our website at xtrabrideslagos.com to see our collections, celebrity clientele (XBL Stars), and real brides gallery. We've dressed celebrities like Davido, Tiwa Savage, Funke Akindele, Mercy Eke, and many more.
